name: ms-argus-pair
description: Argus phone-pair captcha demo — dual-scan co-attestation between desktop and phone

scripts.spell: cspell lint "{cdk,docs,loader,src,tests,scripts}/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,mjs,js,md}" README.md LLM_DEV_LOOP.md ATTACK_TESTING.md package.json
scripts.boundaries: depcruise cdk loader src tests --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs
scripts.test:hygiene: npm run test:cleanup-ratchets && npm run test:cdk-hardening && node scripts/assert-build-hygiene.mjs && npm run test:argus-loader-sri && npm run test:proof-menu && npm run test:phone-scan-background && npm run test:phone-challenge-continuity && npm run test:phone-entry-build && npm run test:sso-continuity && npm run test:sso-routes && npm run test:sso-demo-ux && npm run test:sso-widget-entry && npm run test:embed-single-scan && npm run test:verdict-challenge && npm run test:qr-connected && npm run test:ws-single && npm run test:spa-router && npm run test:reveal-gate
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run spell && npm run boundaries && npm run dead-code && npm run duplication && npm run test:cleanup-ratchets && npm run test:coverage
scripts.deploy: source .env 2>/dev/null; PAIR_HOST=$(node cdk/bin/print-pair-host.mjs) && WS_URL=$(node cdk/bin/print-ws-url.mjs) && VITE_PAIR_URL_BASE="https://${PAIR_HOST}" VITE_PAIR_WS_URL="${WS_URL}" npm run build && EMBED_ORIGIN="https://${PAIR_HOST}" npm run build:loader && npm run test:hygiene && node cdk/bin/assert-baked-host.mjs "${PAIR_HOST}" && npx cdk deploy --all -c merchantApiUrl="${MERCHANT_API_URL:-}" -c merchantApiCredential="${MERCHANT_API_CREDENTIAL:-}" -c merchantCpi="${MERCHANT_CPI:-}" -c ssoCallbackOrigins="${SSO_CALLBACK_ORIGINS:-}" -c oauthGoogleClientId="${OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-}" --require-approval never
